summary: Relocation mid-probation: hardware handback vs local issuance, KMS rekey and SSO group changes for APAC transfer
description:
Issue summary: Senior Data Engineer (internal headcount) has requested permanent relocation from US to APAC office mid-probation (start date 2026-02-02). HR needs guidance on whether to require return of company laptop (MacBook Pro M1) shipped to US or allow device to remain with employee and provision a new APAC-managed device. Request also asks for KMS/HSM key custody plan and SSO/SCIM group mapping changes so that user appears in APAC org unit without duplicate accounts.

Impact: Decisions will affect compliance (local import/export/tax reporting), KMS key material residency, license seat accounting, and security posture if device remains outside original region. Employee is handling customer data classified as Confidential; we must ensure no residual US-only secrets remain accessible.

Background: HR and hiring manager prefer minimal disruption and would like to avoid international courier return if policy allows. Security & Compliance flagged need to rotate encrypted volumes, service account tokens, and re-enroll device in regional MDM. Current SCIM sync shows duplicate person record during test move (observed 2026-03-09).

Request: 1) Operational checklist for safely transferring or repatriating laptop across regions (including remote-wipe, decryption, KMS rekey, MDM re-enroll). 2) Policy clarification: acceptable to keep original device in new country if it is wiped and re-enrolled vs mandatory return + new issuance. 3) Steps to avoid duplicate SCIM/SSO accounts during org unit change and how to safely migrate group membership and SSO bindings. 4) Proposed timeline and point people (SRE/KMS/Ops/HR) for an expedited path if employee relocation occurs within 7 business days.
steps_to_complete: Confirm employment status and relocation approval with HR (Maya)
Inventory device serial, asset tag, and current KMS key associations
Schedule remote wipe and file-level encryption verification with Endpoint team
If device retained: perform factory wipe, rotate LUKS/FileVault keys, revoke old KMS grants, create new KMS key in apac region, and re-enroll in APAC MDM
If device returned: generate return shipping label, coordinate customs paperwork with Legal, receive device into inventory and reimage before redeployment
Run SCIM dry-run: move user to APAC org unit in staging, validate no duplicate identity created, capture reconciliation steps
Rotate any service account tokens the user had access to and rotate personal access keys
Update asset and license records and notify Finance for tax/benefit implications
investigation_notes: 2026-03-09: SCIM test migration created a duplicate identity in staging when the externalId field was missing from the payload. Hypothesis: HR MS Graph connector not supplying persistent externalId for relocated users.
Checked KMS policy bindings: laptop encrypted volume key is a customer-managed envelope key (CMK) in us-west-2 with grants to user's Okta service principal. No cross-region replication configured.
MDM enrollment shows device last checked-in from IP range assigned to contractor campus in US. Endpoint team confirms MDM certificate can be revoked and reissued remotely.
No outstanding legal holds currently on employee records (confirmed with Legal 2026-03-10).
comments: Maya Patel 2026-03-10: Adding HR context — relocation approved by manager; requested earliest start in APAC office 2026-03-18. Prefer *device stay* option if compliant to avoid courier delays.
Luis Romero 2026-03-10: Assigning to IAM/Endpoint/KMS teams to draft operational checklist. Will coordinate SCIM dry-run in staging. Need Legal input on customs/tax risk.

Priya Nair (Compliance) 2026-03-11: From a compliance perspective we prefer a new locally-issued device for employees handling Confidential customer data unless MDM re-enrollment and KMS rekey are performed and documented. Will add requirement for attestation form.
Endpoint Team (via ticket) 2026-03-11: Can perform remote factory reset and re-enroll. Need asset serial and current Okta UID. ETA for wipe plan: 48 hours after approval.
Legal (Samir Khan) 2026-03-12: Provided contact at international carrier for customs paperwork; flagged potential VAT/tax implications if device considered 'gift' — Finance must be looped in.
resolution: In progress — operational checklist drafted by Endpoint and IAM. Next steps: HR to confirm decision (retain vs return) by 2026-03-13; if retain, Endpoint to schedule remote wipe and KMS team to create apac CMK and perform key rotation. Legal/Finance will finalize customs/tax guidance.
